:::{#exm-information-equality}
#### Checking the information equality for Poisson data

For $\dsn{X} \siid \Pois(\rate)$,
the score is $\score = \sumin X_i/\rate - n$
(@exm-information-poisson). Then:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{\score}
&= \E{\frac{\sumin X_i}{\rate} - n}
&& \text{(Poisson score)}\\
&= \E{\frac{\sumin X_i}{\rate}} - \E{n}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\frac{\sumin X_i}{\rate}} - n
&& \text{(the expectation of a constant is that constant)}\\
&= \frac{\E{\sumin X_i}}{\rate} - n
&& \text{(factor the constant $\tfrac{1}{\rate}$ out of the expectation)}\\
&= \frac{\sumin \E{X_i}}{\rate} - n
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \frac{\sumin \rate}{\rate} - n
&& \text{($\E{X_i} = \rate$)}\\
&= \frac{n\rate}{\rate} - n
&& \text{(sum of $n$ copies of $\rate$)}\\
&= n - n
&& \text{(cancel $\rate$)}\\
&= 0
&& \text{(subtract)}\\
\Var{\score}
&= \Var{\frac{\sumin X_i}{\rate} - n}
&& \text{(Poisson score)}\\
&= \Var{\frac{\sumin X_i}{\rate}}
&& \text{(subtracting a constant does not change a variance)}\\
&= \frac{\Var{\sumin X_i}}{\rate^2}
&& \text{($\Var{aY} = a^2 \Var{Y}$)}\\
&= \frac{\sumin \Var{X_i}}{\rate^2}
&& \text{(variance of a sum of independent variables)}\\
&= \frac{\sumin \rate}{\rate^2}
&& \text{($\Var{X_i} = \rate$)}\\
&= \frac{n\rate}{\rate^2}
&& \text{(sum of $n$ copies of $\rate$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{\rate}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\rate$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

which matches $\einf(\rate) = n/\rate$ from @exm-information-poisson.
:::
